purpose: Document first-party local registry/map evidence and bounded anonymous parcel-geometry access review.
assessment: Yiwu has a concrete city registration center and active cadastral mapping administration. The city’s documented personal-file service is rights-holder restricted; no safe anonymous full-polygon city service was verified. No property-owner, address or account lookup was submitted. No full geometry sample was retained.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official 2025 Yiwu Natural Resources and Real Estate Registration Center budget: city center handles registration of land, housing, forests and rural contracted land; maintains registration-information platform and files cadastral survey/mapping results.

Official city government Q&A says the Zhejiang registration platform allows the rights holder to check their own registration information online; non-right-holders must use the service archive desk with identity documents and authorization. No property lookup was attempted.

Official city Natural Resources and Planning Bureau 2025 procurement notice includes a project for completing Yiwu rural homestead and collective construction-land cadastral data and compiling cadastral maps; it is a specific land-parcel mapping program, not an anonymous vector service.

Official Yiwu Natural Resources and Planning Bureau role includes city land/resource administration, cadastral registration duties, survey/geospatial output oversight and management of public geospatial services.

attempts.result: Confirms online query is for rights-holder’s own records; other users must show identity/authorization at service counter. No record lookup submitted.
Confirms cadastral data/map-production activity for a specified rural land program, not public parcel serving.

geometryDisposition: No full geometry sample: reviewed sources did not establish a safe anonymous city parcel geometry response.
